categories.name: مَخْلُوقَاتٌ قُرْآنِيَّةٌ
categories.nameEn: Types of Living Beings in the Quran

items.verse: يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمْ ۚ وَخُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ ضَعِيفًۭا
items.verseEn: And Allāh wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak.
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

items.verse: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّۭ فِى كِتَـٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
items.verseEn: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allāh is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.

items.verse: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ ۖ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَـٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
items.verseEn: But they have attributed to Allāh partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Exalted is He and high above what they describe.

categories.name: أَصْحَابُ الْوَيْلِ فِي الْمَاعُونِ
categories.nameEn: The People of Woe in Surah Al-Ma'un

items.verseEn: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray

items.verseEn: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

categories.name: الْمَوْصُوفَاتُ بِالْمُبِينِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Things Described as 'Clear' in the Quran

items.verseEn: These are the verses of the clear Book.

items.verse: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

items.verse: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
items.verseEn: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

items.verse: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
items.verseEn: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

harf.hint: The name of the religion that means 'submission to God'
harf.arabicVerse: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَـٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
harf.verse: 49:17 - They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

deduction.title: Between Earth and Sky
deduction.intro: A mysterious soul awaits you in the sacred pages of divine history, carrying signs and wonders that still echo through the ages. As you follow the trail of clues, you will journey through a story marked by miracles — from a miraculous beginning to an ascent beyond the sky. Can you identify this blessed servant before the final clue?
clues: I was sent as a messenger to the Children of Israel with tidings of mercy and light.
My birth was a miraculous sign — I came into this world without a father, by the command of the Almighty.
I spoke while still an infant, defending my mother's honor against the accusations of her people.
By Allah's permission, I shaped birds from clay and breathed life into them — they flew away before the eyes of those who watched.
I healed those born blind, cured the leper, and even raised the dead — yet every miracle was by Allah's leave, not my own.
When my enemies plotted to destroy me, Allah raised me to the heavens and promised my return before the Day of Judgment.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Isa (Jesus)
Prophet Musa (Moses)
Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham)
Prophet Muhammad
Prophet Yusuf (Joseph)

trial.label: The Defining Moment
options: I was raised to the heavens
I was thrown into a blazing fire
I faced Pharaoh's mighty army
I was swallowed by a great whale
I built an ark upon the mountain
trial.answer: I was raised to the heavens

location.label: Sacred Sign Performed
options: I shaped birds from clay
I turned a staff into a serpent
I split the moon in two
I commanded the wind and jinn
I brought forth a she-camel from a rock

outcome.label: What Became of Me
options: Raised to the heavens; promised to return
Became a great ruler of an empire
Led my people out of captivity
Was given unmatched earthly wealth
Was reunited with my family after long separation
outcome.answer: Raised to the heavens; promised to return

deduction.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
deduction.verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)

scramble.hint: The delightful reward awaiting the righteous believers in the Hereafter.
scramble.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍۢ يُحْبَرُونَ
scramble.verseEn: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
